This idea was well-received, with suggestions to include snacks and treats from each participant to share, as a way to foster a sense of camaraderie and enjoyment while the group plans and implements the garden improvements. The intention behind this approach is to create a lively and cooperative atmosphere that encourages creativity, participation, and community bonding.
